spec.name: Orange Kitchen Dough
spec.description: A soft mound of freshly mixed flour-and-water dough with rounded, stepped shoulders, a thick folded flap and tucked ends. Pale wheat and ivory flour shading keep it recognizably raw and ready to cook.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Dough. Recognizable prepared cooking ingredient. Flour/salt/grounds in a small open paper packet or bowl, liquids in a little bottle, dough soft and folded, meat textured and distinct. Pick the correct form for the item. Actual recipe ingredients: flour, water bottle. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
